findings.fix: Add `dualCarrierEquiv_refl : (Isometry.refl L).dualCarrierEquiv = LinearEquiv.refl ℤ L.dualCarrier` and `dualCarrierEquiv_trans : (e.trans f).dualCarrierEquiv = e.dualCarrierEquiv.trans f.dualCarrierEquiv` (each `ext x; apply Subtype.ext; simp` — this is exactly the content currently inlined at lines 180-181 and 208-211), mirroring the existing `Isometry.carrierEquiv_refl`/`carrierEquiv_symm`/`carrierEquiv_trans` triple. Then close the three discriminant lemmas by rewriting with `Submodule.Quotient.equiv_refl` / `Submodule.Quotient.equiv_symm` / `Submodule.Quotient.equiv_trans` plus the dual-carrier lemma, instead of quotient induction.
findings.issue: `discriminantGroupEquiv_refl`, `discriminantGroupEquiv_symm` and `discriminantGroupEquiv_trans` (lines 172-211) each reprove, by `Submodule.Quotient.induction_on` + `congr 1` + `Subtype.ext`, the functoriality of `Submodule.Quotient.equiv` that Mathlib already states: `Submodule.Quotient.equiv_refl` (Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Quotient/Basic.lean:426), `Submodule.Quotient.equiv_symm` (ibid.:344, proved by `rfl`) and `Submodule.Quotient.equiv_trans` (ibid.:349). Since `discriminantGroupEquiv` is literally `Submodule.Quotient.equiv ... e.dualCarrierEquiv e.map_carrierInDual` (line 159), the only missing ingredients are the corresponding facts one level down; `dualCarrierEquiv_symm` is already present at line 137, but the refl and trans analogues are inlined into the quotient proofs instead of being stated.

summary: The new material is genuinely new and reuses Mathlib's dualSubmodule/quotient API well. One issue: the three isometry-functoriality proofs re-derive Submodule.Quotient.equiv_refl/_symm/_trans by hand instead of applying them.
